# SWOTBee: HubSpot & Shopify Consulting
# https://swotbee.com
# Updated: 2026-07-24

SWOTBee is a HubSpot and Shopify consulting firm serving mid-sized companies
(50 to 100 employees) in Energy, Utilities, SaaS, Construction, and Manufacturing.
We help RevOps and Customer Success teams build renewal pipelines, automate
deal cloning for renewals, fix commission tracking, and stop revenue leakage
in HubSpot.
